extDescription.message: Translate selected text with page context into your chosen language. Save results and sources to local Markdown.

effortHint.message: Independent of speed. Lower effort usually responds sooner.

speedHint.message: Changes the service tier only, not reasoning effort.

speedSupported.message: Reasoning effort stays unchanged. Latency varies; quota usage may increase.

speedUnavailable.message: This model uses standard service. Reasoning effort remains independent.

notesHint.message: The flag saves the original, translation, explanation, context and page source.

settingsSaved.message: Settings saved. Changes apply to the next translation.

copyFailed.message: Could not copy. Select and copy the translation manually.

targetHint.message: Translation, explanation and context use this language. The interface follows Chrome.

languageCode.message: Language code, e.g. en, zh-Hant, fil

privacyShort.message: Text, nearby paragraphs and limited page context are sent to your Codex model provider only when you request a translation.

tagline.message: Local Codex · Understand while you read

capabilitiesHint.message: Available models and reasoning levels depend on your local Codex.

stepTranslate.message: Right-click Quick Translate, or press Alt+Shift+T.

stepSave.message: Resize from any corner. Use the flag to save.

installIntro.message: Windows is currently supported. Download the companion, extract it to a fixed folder and run this command in PowerShell from that folder:

requirements.message: Requires Node.js 20+ and an installed, signed-in Codex. Store users do not need to load another unpacked extension.

privacyLong.message: Only on translation, selected text, nearby paragraphs and up to 16,000 characters of page content are sent to your configured Codex model provider. Inference runs in the cloud; the local companion connects and saves files.

limitations.message: Fast service may consume more quota. Internal Chrome pages, the Web Store, some cross-origin frames and the built-in PDF viewer do not support the floating panel.

independent.message: Independently developed; not affiliated with OpenAI or Google.

errorSelectionLarge.message: Select at most 12,000 characters per translation.

errorPage.message: Translation is unavailable on this page. Use an ordinary webpage.

errorSender.message: This page cannot access the local translator.

errorExpired.message: This translation has expired. Translate it again.

errorHostConnect.message: Cannot connect to the local companion: $value1$. Run the installer and retry.

errorHostTimeout.message: The local companion timed out. Retry.

errorModel.message: The selected model is unavailable. Choose another model.

errorEffort.message: This model does not support that reasoning effort.

errorInvalidLanguage.message: Enter a valid language code, for example en, zh-Hant or fil.

errorInvalidPath.message: Enter an absolute local .md file path.

errorLocalPath.message: Only Markdown files on local drives are supported.

errorDevicePath.message: Paths cannot contain device names or trailing spaces or dots.

errorLinkedPath.message: Cannot save to links, directories or files with multiple hard links.

errorChangedPath.message: The file is a link or was replaced. Saving was refused.

errorExecutablePath.message: The Codex executable must have an absolute path.

errorCodexMissing.message: No working Codex installation found. Run the installer again.

errorConcurrent.message: Up to four translations can run at once. Stop one or wait.

errorNoOutput.message: The model returned no translation. Retry.

errorModelMismatch.message: Codex did not use the requested settings: $value1$. Change settings and retry.

errorMessageSize.message: The local message exceeded the size limit.

errorUpdateHost.message: Update the local companion to version 1.3.0 or later to use target languages.

supplementalModel.message: Official model missing from the local picker catalog.
